issues.problem: AC-13 expects a toast 'Rated 4 out of 5', but F4 (SPEC.md and spec.json) defines no rating toast. The toast text is also the same as the accessible name of the star display, so a Playwright getByLabel/getByRole('...', {name:'Rated 4 out of 5'}) locator will match two elements while the toast is visible and fail strict mode.
issues.fix: In F4, define rating toasts that differ from the display name, e.g. 'Rating saved' after rating and 'Rating cleared' after Clear rating. Update AC-13 to expect the toast 'Rating saved' and then an element named 'Rated 4 out of 5' that is still there after a reload. Add toast 'Rating cleared' to AC-15.

issues.where: F3 | F4 | F1 | F6 | SPEC.md#features (error states)
issues.problem: The only error state specified is the route-level error boundary. Nothing says what happens when a mutation fails (status change, rating, save, delete, restore) or what the UI shows while a mutation is pending. Inline status selects and star buttons are optimistic-looking controls, so without a rule the builder will either leave the UI in the wrong state or leave the failure unhandled.
issues.fix: Add to F10: 'While saving, the submit button is disabled and reads "Saving…". If any mutation fails, the control reverts to its previous value and an error toast "Couldn't save changes. Try again." appears.' Add a non-e2e (or unit-level) AC that covers the server action returning an error for the status change.

issues.problem: AC-5 calls the rating control in the Add form a 'Rating' group, while F4 labels it 'Rate this book'. It is also unclear whether the stars in the form are toggle/selection buttons that must not submit the form, and whether a rating chosen in the form can be cleared before saving.
issues.fix: State in F1: 'When Status is Finished, a radiogroup labeled "Rating" with options "Rate 1 star"…"Rate 5 stars" appears (type=button, does not submit), plus "Clear rating". Switching Status away from Finished discards the chosen rating.' Keep AC-5 as is and add an AC: create as Finished with 'Rate 5 stars', and the new card shows 'Rated 5 out of 5'.

issues.problem: Pluralization is not specified. '{Mon YYYY}: N books' and '{finished} of {goal} books' would produce '1 books' and '0 books'. It is also unclear whether empty months render as a bar named '… : 0 books'.
issues.fix: Specify: 'Use "1 book" and "N books" (including 0) everywhere. All 12 months render a bar even when the count is 0, named e.g. "Mar 2026: 0 books".'

issues.problem: Seed dates are loosely defined ('spread across the previous 11 months, at least one in the current month'). So 'Finished this year' and the per-month counts after a restore are non-deterministic, and depending on the month some finished books fall into the previous calendar year. Added and started dates for seed books are also unspecified.
issues.fix: Give an exact finished-month offset per finished seed book (e.g. Hobbit 0, Dune 1, Circe 2, Remains 4, Educated 6, Station Eleven 8, Earthsea 10 months ago, day 1 or today's day clamped). Set started = finished − 14 days, added = started − 7 days, Reading books started 5 days ago, and Want-to-read added 1–3 days ago, ordered so 'Piranesi' is the most recently added.

issues.problem: It is not specified whether the tab counts ('Want to read · N') reflect the active search query, or whether switching tabs preserves ?q and ?sort. 'Search, sort and status tab combine' leaves both readings open.
issues.fix: State: 'Tab counts always reflect the full library, ignoring search. Tab links preserve the current q and sort params.' Add an AC: on /?status=finished, search 'le guin', and exactly 'A Wizard of Earthsea' is shown with the URL containing status=finished&q=le+guin (any order).

issues.problem: SPEC.md F3 omits the rule 'moving to Want to read clears the started date', which appears only in the assumptions and in the spec.json F3. It also does not say whether changing Status in the Edit form (F6) applies the same date and rating rules.
issues.fix: Add the Want-to-read rule to SPEC.md F3, and add: 'Status changes made through the Edit form follow exactly the same date/rating rules as the quick status select.'

issues.problem: Max lengths (Title 200, Author 120, Notes 2000) have no defined error messages or enforcement mechanism. Whitespace-only titles are not addressed, and there is no AC for Edit-form validation.
issues.fix: Specify: 'Values are trimmed; whitespace-only counts as empty. Over-length shows "Title must be 200 characters or fewer" / "Author must be 120 characters or fewer" / "Notes must be 2000 characters or fewer" (server-validated too).' Add an AC: clearing Title on /books/{id}/edit and saving shows 'Title is required' and stays on the edit URL.

issues.problem: The generic 'Page not found' for unknown paths has no AC. spec.json lists its path as '/404', while SPEC.md says it applies to any unknown path. The loading skeletons and the error boundary have no acceptance criteria at all.
issues.fix: Set the Not found path to '* (any unmatched route)' in spec.json. Add AC: opening /nope shows 'Page not found' and 'Back to library' navigates to /. Add a non-e2e AC: the library, detail and stats routes each have a loading.tsx skeleton, and an error.tsx rendering 'Something went wrong' with a 'Try again' button that calls reset().

issues.problem: Theme is controlled in two places (the Settings Light/Dark/System choice and the header toggle), but their interaction is undefined. What does the toggle do when the theme is System? AC-33 also assumes 'light theme' while the default is System. There is no AC for the Settings theme choice.
issues.fix: Specify: 'The header toggle sets an explicit theme opposite to the currently resolved theme; Settings shows the resulting choice selected.' In AC-33, change the given to 'Theme set to Light in Settings'. Add an AC: choosing 'Dark' in Settings adds class 'dark' to <html>, and it persists after a reload.

issues.problem: Soft delete lifecycle is unspecified. The spec does not say whether soft-deleted books are excluded from stats and counts, when they are purged, whether 'Delete all books' is soft or hard, or whether 'Restore demo data' also resets the reading goal.
issues.fix: Add assumptions: 'Soft-deleted books are excluded from every list, count and stat. They are purged on the next delete, delete-all or restore. Delete all and Restore demo data are hard operations without undo. Restore demo data also clears the reading goal.'

issues.problem: Stat cards and distribution rows have no defined accessible structure, so a test cannot reliably pair the label 'Reading' with '2', especially since 'Reading' also appears in the nav, tabs and distribution text.
issues.fix: Specify: 'Each stat card is a <section> or group with aria-label equal to its title (e.g. "Pages read") that contains the value. Each distribution row is a listitem with the accessible text "5 stars: 3".' Reference these names in AC-17 and AC-18.

issues.problem: Goal validation has no error message, cancelling or clearing a goal is unspecified, and the goal input's label is undefined.
issues.fix: Specify: the input is labeled 'Books this year' with a 'Save goal' button. An invalid value shows 'Enter a whole number from 1 to 999'. When a goal is set, the button reads 'Edit goal'. There is a 'Remove goal' action. Add an AC for entering 0, which shows the error.

issues.problem: The behavior of 'Pick another' is unspecified when only one Want to read book exists, and it is unclear whether it may repeat the current pick.
issues.fix: Specify: 'Pick another chooses a different book than the one shown when possible; with a single candidate it is disabled.'

issues.problem: Search input timing is undefined (live vs submit, debounce), which affects both the URL-sync ACs and test flakiness.
issues.fix: Specify: 'Search filters live with a 300 ms debounce and replaces (not pushes) the history entry. An empty query removes q from the URL.'
